summary: This album leaf was painted by Pu Ru (1896-1963), a member of the Qing imperial family and a cousin of the last emperor. Known for his exceptionally elegant paintings in classical style, Pu Ru was one of the most famous and most talented poets, painters, and calligraphers of the first half of the twentieth century.
